verdict.rationale: A recorded hands-on run shows the `npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development` command actually fetching and installing just one named skill folder into a project, confirming selective install is real and functional. However, the primary documented Claude Code install path (`/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`) appears to add the whole plugin/bundle rather than individual skills, and other harness installers (Devin, Hermes) are described as whole-plugin installs too, so selective install isn't uniformly available across all supported harnesses. Missing for 10: confirmation that plugin-marketplace and other harness installers (not just the npx CLI) also support picking individual skills, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration of selective install behavior.
